High heat may have destroyed its soft glow, but it's now fragrant and tasty.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Toasty Silent Shrooms are a type of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] can make Toasty Silent Shrooms by burning [[Silent Shroom]]s with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} While they have lost their glowing properties, they are noted to be fragrant. When Link eats a Toasty Silent Shroom, he will heal three-quarters of a [[Heart]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Toasty Silent Shrooms reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by allowing [[Silent Shroom]]s to come into contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Toasty Silent Shrooms are known to be delicious and fragrant, although they no longer glow in the dark. Eating a Toasty Silent Shroom will restore three-quarters of one of Link's [[Heart]]s. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Roasted Food * Silent Shroom }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
